end.summary:
Practised teen numbers as one ten and some more.
Counted examples including 13, 14, 16, 17, and 18.
Identified that the 1 in a teen number represents one ten.
Corrected counting a full bundle as ten during the lesson.
Digit order in 14 remained mixed up by the end; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised making teen numbers with one full bundle of ten and loose ones. Saanvi used counting-on to correct the bundle mix-up and explained that the 1 means one ten. They changed 41 to 14 once, but later still mixed up the digit order. At home, build numbers such as 14 and 18 with ten objects plus loose ones, then write the number while saying “one ten and four” or “one ten and eight.”
